description: One clear spear thrust to the right and recovery. Lower the raised spear to horizontal, pull the arms back slightly, thrust the spear decisively toward the right with both hands, then retract it and return to the original guard. Keep feet planted with a small forward body lean. Preserve the spear length, face, dorsal fins and tail. No walking, spinning, particles, magic, floating dots, trails or detached fragments.
subject_description: cobalt blue perch fish spearman with cream belly, spiny dorsal fin, amber eye, two arms and two short legs, wooden spear with silver blade
